concerns.text: T016 hard-codes a 'reduce k by 1' loop and explicitly forbids HAC fallback. This violates the Plan's 'Manifold Robustness Mitigation' section which mandates a fallback to HAC if K-means diagnostics fail, and contradicts Spec FR-002a which leaves the reduction step as '[deferred]'.

T018 enforces a hard abort (exit code 1) if clustering coverage < 98%. Spec SC-005 only defines this as a metric to be measured and reported; it does not define a hard pass/fail gate that terminates the research pipeline, violating the principle that planning docs defer empirical thresholds.

T032a requires an external 'vla_proxy_baseline.parquet' artifact to exist but provides no task to generate or validate this input. This leaves SC-001 (fidelity measurement) unimplementable without an undefined external hand-off, violating the 'Reproducibility' principle (Constitution I) which requires results to be reproducible by re-running the project's code/data.

T042 measures memory usage of the inference engine as a standalone subprocess. SC-003 requires measuring computational cost in the context of the full pipeline constraints (≤ 7GB RAM total). Isolating the inference script ignores the memory overhead of loading datasets/artifacts, failing to verify the system constraint.

T037a explicitly forbids calculating the 'complexity reduction factor' claiming it is 'not defined in the Spec'. However, Spec US-03 Acceptance Scenario 3 explicitly requires the report to state the 'complexity reduction factor'. This task silently drops a required deliverable.
